title: 第704章 别擦掉哦这我们俩留给你的印记第703章 以为你要欺负我结果你没有这就不是在欺负我吗
slug: 我反派魔尊开局被清冷师尊强吻
content_zh:
那磨蹭的力道恰到好处，尾尖那撮细密的绒毛在他的掌纹上来回扫过，带来一阵又一阵若有若无的酥痒。
她的尾巴光滑而富有弹性，在他掌心里扭动时的触感如同一尾被阳光晒暖的游鱼，每一次摆动都精准地擦过他掌心最敏感的那几处穴位。
见状，江尘羽也没有辜负主动的魔清秋。
他本来只是想简单地握着两条尾巴、享受一下左拥右抱的惬意。
但既然清秋这么主动地用自己的尾巴在他掌心里蹭来蹭去，他若是再没有任何回应，那便真的是不解风情了。
于是他顺着她的意愿开始抚摸起了她那光滑且手感极佳的尾巴，他的手指从之前简单的握持变成了更加细致、更加富有技巧的抚摸。
他先从她尾巴的中段开始，沿着尾巴外侧那条光滑的弧线缓缓向上滑去，指腹在尾骨两侧那两条极细微的肌肉沟壑上来回摩挲。
然后他的食指与中指加入了进来，两根手指分别从尾巴的内外两侧夹住尾身，沿着尾巴的弧线从根部向尾尖缓缓推进，每推进一寸便极轻极快地用指腹在那一小片区域上画一个极小的圈，然后再继续向前。
当他的手指终于滑到她的尾尖时，他用拇指与食指极轻极轻地捻起了尾尖上那一小撮最细密、最敏感的绒毛。
如同在捻起一朵蒲公英的种子般，江尘羽用指腹极轻极缓地揉搓着那一小撮绒毛，力道轻得几乎不可察觉，却因为那份不可察觉而更加撩人心弦。
而被抚摸着尾巴，魔清秋顿时也露出一副享受的模样。
她的眼眸微微眯起，那双平日里总是闪烁着狡黠与促狭光芒的妩媚眼眸此刻半垂着，瞳孔深处翻涌着几分餍足的迷离。
她的唇角向上弯起一个餍足的弧度，那弧度里有几分得意，显然是满足于江尘羽那熟练得让人头皮发麻的抚摸手法。
她的身体也在他的抚摸下不由自主地微微放松了几分，原本紧紧贴在他胸膛上的饱满随着她逐渐平稳的呼吸而轻轻起伏，那件蓝色泳衣的面料在泉水的浸润下紧紧贴在她胸前，勾勒出一道优美而诱人的弧线。
热辣魅魔惬意地闭起了眼睛感受生命之泉对她身体的滋养。
温热的泉水从四面八方将她包裹，水中的生命之力顺着她的毛孔缓缓渗入经脉，而江尘羽的手指则在她尾巴上持续不断地施展着那套让她无比受用的抚摸手法。
两种截然不同的舒适感同时作用于她的身体，如同两股温暖的洋流在她体内交汇融合，让她整个人都陷入了一种极度放松的状态。
她甚至极轻极轻地发出了一声满足的喟叹，那喟叹从她微微张开的唇瓣间逸出，在氤氲的水雾中化作一缕极淡极淡的白烟。
而望着魔清秋所流露出幸福模样，场中红颜的神情顿时就变得微妙了起来。
诗钰小萝莉的目光在魔清秋那张写满了餍足与享受的脸上停留了好几息，然后低头看了看自己。

她的嘴角不由自主地向下弯了一个极细微的弧度。
然后她抬起手，用指尖戳了戳身旁小玉那条正浮在水面上惬意摇晃的雪貂尾巴。
那动作里有几分羡慕，也有几分“为什么我没有这种好东西”的哀怨。
小玉被她戳得尾巴一抖，回头用那双琥珀色的眼眸莫名其妙地看了她一眼，然后又将尾巴重新舒展开来，继续在水面上惬意地画着圈。
......
正如她们期盼的那般，自己心爱的男子确实是来到了她们的身边。
她们等了一个时辰，好不容易盼到江尘羽从蝶衣身边站起身、赤足踏过青石板朝她们走来。
那一刻她们每一个人心中都泛起了一阵难以言喻的雀跃——期待着他会在自己身边坐下，期待着能听到他在自己耳边用那种低沉而温柔的声音说几句让人脸红心跳的话。
但他却把所有心思都放在了那对姐妹花那灵活的尾巴上面。
从他在清雨身边坐下到现在，他的左手握着清秋的尾巴，右手握着清雨的尾巴起，他的全部注意力都被这两条尾巴牢牢地吸引了过去。
这无疑令她们心中浮现起一抹小小的醋意。
那醋意极淡极淡，淡到在场的每一位红颜都不会真的因此而生气。
但那份醋意又确实存在，如同水面上荡开的一圈圈细密涟漪，虽然不汹涌，却也足以让她们的心湖泛起几分微妙的波动。
content_en:
The rubbing force was just right, and the fine fluff at the tip of his tail swept back and forth across his palm prints, causing waves of subtle itching.
Her tail was smooth and elastic. When it twisted in his palm, it felt like a swimming fish warmed by the sun. Each swing accurately brushed against the most sensitive acupuncture points in his palm.
Seeing this, Jiang Chenyu did not let down Mo Qingqiu who took the initiative.
He originally just wanted to simply hold the two tails and enjoy the comfort of being hugged on the left and right.
But since Qingqiu took the initiative to rub her tail in his palm, if he didn't respond at all, it would be really confusing.
So he followed her wishes and began to stroke her smooth and tactile tail. His fingers changed from a simple holding to a more detailed and skillful stroking.
He started from the middle of her tail and slowly slid upward along the smooth arc on the outside of the tail. His fingertips rubbed back and forth on the two extremely fine muscle grooves on both sides of the tailbone.
Then his index finger and middle finger joined in. The two fingers clamped the tail body from the inner and outer sides of the tail, and slowly pushed forward along the arc of the tail from the root to the tip. Every inch he advanced, he used his fingertips to draw a very small circle on that small area very lightly and quickly, and then continued forward.
When his fingers finally slid to the tip of her tail, he used his thumb and index finger to gently twist the handful of the finest and most sensitive down on the tip of her tail.
As if twisting the seeds of a dandelion, Jiang Chenyu rubbed the small handful of down with his fingertips very gently and slowly. The force was so light that it was almost imperceptible, but it was even more sultry because of the imperceptibility.
As his tail was stroked, Mo Qingqiu suddenly showed a look of enjoyment.
Her eyes narrowed slightly, and her charming eyes, which usually shone with cunning and narrow-mindedness, were half-lowered at the moment, with a bit of satisfied confusion surging deep in her pupils.
The corners of her lips curved upward in a satisfying arc, and there was a bit of pride in that arc. She was obviously satisfied with Jiang Chenyu's skillful stroking technique that made people's scalp numb.
Her body also involuntarily relaxed slightly under his touch. The fullness that had been tightly attached to his chest rose and fell gently with her gradually steady breathing. The fabric of the blue swimsuit was soaked by the spring water and clung to her chest, outlining a beautiful and alluring arc.
The hot succubus closed her eyes in comfort and felt the nourishment of the fountain of life on her body.
The warm spring water enveloped her from all directions, and the life force in the water slowly seeped into her meridians along her pores, while Jiang Chenyu's fingers continued to use the stroking technique on her tail that was extremely useful to her.
Two completely different feelings of comfort acted on her body at the same time, like two warm ocean currents meeting and merging in her body, making her whole body fall into a state of extreme relaxation.
She even let out a very soft sigh of satisfaction, which escaped from her slightly opened lips and turned into a very light white smoke in the mist.
Looking at Mo Qingqiu's happy expression, the expression on the beauty's face suddenly became subtle.
Shiyu's little loli's eyes lingered on Mo Qingqiu's face full of satisfaction and enjoyment for several breaths, and then she looked down at herself.
The corners of her mouth involuntarily curved downward in a very slight arc.
Then she raised her hand and poked Xiaoyu's ferret tail beside her with her fingertips, which was floating and swaying comfortably on the water.
There was a bit of envy in that action, but also a bit of sadness "Why don't I have such a good thing?"
Xiaoyu's tail twitched when she poked her, and she turned around to look at her inexplicably with her amber eyes. Then she stretched her tail out again and continued to draw circles on the water comfortably.
...
Just as they expectedJust like that, the man they loved did come to them.
They waited for an hour, finally expecting Jiang Chenyu to stand up from Dieyi, step on the bluestone with bare feet and walk toward them.
At that moment, each of them felt an indescribable excitement in their hearts - looking forward to him sitting down next to them, looking forward to hearing him say a few words in their ears in that low and gentle voice that made people blush and heartbeat.
But he put all his thoughts on the flexible tails of the sisters.
From the moment he sat down next to Qingyu until now, he held Qingqiu's tail in his left hand and Qingyu's tail in his right hand. All his attention was firmly attracted by these two tails.
This undoubtedly made them feel a little jealous.
The jealousy was very light, so light that every beauty present would not really be angry because of it.
But the jealousy does exist, just like the fine ripples on the water. Although it is not turbulent, it is enough to make their hearts wave slightly.
